steps.title: Check AI can read your store
steps.how: Open sampledishco.example/robots.txt. Make sure it doesn't block Googlebot, OAI-SearchBot or PerplexityBot. Google, ChatGPT and Perplexity use them to read your pages. If one is blocked, remove that rule.

steps.title: Put the key facts first on every product page
steps.how: Start each page with one plain line: what it is, who it's for, and the main facts like size and what it's made of. Do your best sellers first, then the rest of your 34 products.

steps.title: Use the words shoppers search
steps.how: Put "natural dish soap" in the title and first line of the product page it fits. About 1,900 searches a month. Do the same with "dish soap" on your collection page. About 6,600 searches a month.

steps.title: Add a short FAQ to your product pages
steps.how: Answer the questions shoppers ask AI, like "Which eco friendly dish soap is gentle on hands?" Put each question in bold, with a short, clear answer under it.

steps.title: Fill in every product's details in Shopify
steps.how: Set the category, product type, tags and each size or colour. AI shopping tools can read these facts, so leave none blank.

steps.title: Write your first buying guide
steps.how: Make it about "best dish soap". About 1,300 searches a month. Answer the question in the first lines. Then compare real options and say who each one suits.

steps.title: Write an honest comparison
steps.how: Compare your natural dish soap with Fern & Suds. AI named Fern & Suds in 11 answers. Be fair, and say where the other side does better too.

steps.title: Add a new guide every week
steps.how: Each one answers one buying question. Next up: "dish soap vs dishwashing liquid" and "dish soap for sensitive skin".

steps.title: Link your guides and products
steps.how: Each guide links to the products it talks about, and each product page links back. It helps shoppers and Google find both.

steps.title: Add something only you have
steps.how: Real photos of your natural dish soap in use, a size chart or a simple table of your range. A page that says what every other page says gives AI no reason to quote you.

steps.title: Email the sites AI trusts
steps.how: Start with greenhomereview.example and kitchenpicks.example. Find the writer's name, say who you are, and ask if your natural dish soap fits their list. Offer to send a sample.

steps.title: Follow up once
steps.how: No reply after a week? Send one short, friendly follow up. Never pay for a spot on a list.

steps.title: Join the chats on Reddit
steps.how: AI used reddit.com in 7 of 24 answers. Search Reddit for "natural dish soap" and help with real questions. Always say you're from Sample Dish Co, and never pretend to be a customer.

steps.title: Ask AI again
steps.how: Ask ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity the same questions we asked. Write down who they name and which sites they use, then compare with this report.

steps.title: Look for visits from AI
steps.how: In Shopify Analytics, see where your visits came from. Look for chatgpt.com, perplexity.ai and gemini.google.com.

steps.title: Keep it going every month
steps.how: Write a new guide each week and update old ones every 2 to 3 months. Ask AI your questions again each month, and email any new sites it starts to use.

script: Episode ___ of helping Aussie brands get picked by AI. Today it's Sample Dish Co.
